alerts.description: Coolify is an open-source and self-hostable tool for managing servers, applications, and databases. This issue is fixed in version 4.0.0-beta.474.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-57260

The PBKDF2-SHA256 password verification function uses standard memcmp() for comparing password hashes instead of a constant-time comparison function. A remote attacker could potentially use timing measurements of LDAP bind attempts to infer partial hash information, though practical exploitation is extremely difficult due to PBKDF2 computational overhead.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59871

This issue is fixed in version 7.5.18.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59873
alerts.description: node-tar is a tar archive manipulation library for Node.js. Prior to 7.5.19, node-tar does not enforce hard upper bounds on total decompressed data, entry counts, or decompression ratio in extraction and parsing paths such as src/extract.ts, allowing a small crafted gzip bomb to exhaust disk space and CPU. This issue is fixed in version 7.5.19.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59874
alerts.description: node-tar is a tar archive manipulation library for Node.js. Prior to 7.5.18, tar.replace accepts a checksum-valid tar header with a negative base-256 encoded entry size, causing the archive scanner to make no progress while repeatedly parsing the same header. This issue is fixed in version 7.5.18.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59875
alerts.description: node-tar is a tar archive manipulation library for Node.js. This issue is fixed in version 7.5.17.

This issue is fixed in version 2.9.0.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59946

alerts.title: CVE-2026-59948

alerts.title: CVE-2026-55778

alerts.description: Parse Server is an open source backend that can be deployed to any infrastructure that can run Node.js. alerts.title: CVE-2026-57481

alerts.title: CVE-2026-4878
alerts.description: A flaw was found in libcap. A local unprivileged user can exploit a Time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the `cap_set_file()` function. This could result in information disclosure, alteration of program execution, or a denial of service.

This could allow modification of SMB-visible file behavior, including converting files into symbolic links or other reparse point types.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50257
alerts.description: A use-after-free flaw was found in the X.Org X server and Xwayland in miSyncDestroyFence(). A client that sets up multiple fence triggers can trigger a use-after-free function pointer call. An attacker would connect to the X server to set up a fence and await that fence, then a second X connection destroys the fence, causing the use-after-free. This may be used to crash the server, or for privilege escalation if the X server runs as root.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50258
alerts.description: A stack-based buffer overflow flaw was found in the X.Org X server and Xwayland. The X server has multiple stack buffers sized XkbMaxShiftLevel * XkbNumKbdGroups but CheckKeyTypes() does not verify or clamp non-canonical key types to XkbMaxShiftLevel. A client can change key types to excessive shift levels and trigger stack overflows. This is caused by an incomplete fix of CVE-2025-26597. This may be used to crash the server, or for privilege escalation if the X server runs as root.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50259

The helper function CheckKeyTypes() writes to this buffer at a client-controlled offset, allowing a stack buffer overflow. This may be used to crash the server, or for privilege escalation if the X server runs as root.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50260
alerts.description: A use-after-free flaw was found in the X.Org X server and Xwayland in FreeCounter(). A client that sets up multiple SyncCounters and awaits on those triggers can trigger a use-after-free when destroying those counters via a second client connection. This may be used to crash the server, or for privilege escalation if the X server runs as root.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50261

This may be used to crash the server, or for privilege escalation if the X server runs as root.

alerts.title: CVE-2026-50262

alerts.title: Open JS Foundationのfast-uriにおける複数の脆弱性
alerts.description: fast-uriのバージョン2.3.1から3.1.2および4.0.0は、HTTP系URLのUnicode（IDN）ホスト名を正規化できません。IDN変換の処理は、グローバルURLコンストラクタに存在しないヘルパー関数を呼び出しており、そのためホスト名は元のUnicode形式のまま静かに残されます。その結果、normalize()やequal()はWHATWG互換のURLパーサーとは異なる値を返します。fast-uriを使用してホストベースのポリシー（拒否リスト、ループバックフィルタリング、リダイレクト検証、アウトバウンドプロキシルーティング）を実施し、その後同じURLをNode.jsのURLやfetchに渡すアプリケーションでは、2つの実装が同じ入力を異なるホストとして解決するため、バイパスが可能となります。修正方法として、3.x系はfast-uri 3.1.3へ、4.x系は4.0.1へアップグレードしてください。回避策としては、実際のリクエストに使用するのと同じURLパーサーでホストポリシーを適用するか、ポリシー検査前に非ASCIIホストを拒否するようにしてください。
